character.description: One young Saudi man in a dark tailored jacket, calm confident posture, appears small beside the monument in early scenes and standing behind the bottle on the table in the reveal
character.appearance: Light olive-brown skin, oval face with defined cheekbones, straight dark eyebrows, dark brown eyes, calm composed expression with a faint confident nod
character.hair: Short black hair in a low fade at the sides, slightly longer textured top swept back
character.grooming: Neatly trimmed black beard with a sharp cheek line and clean neckline, no jewelry except a slim dark watch
character.build: Slim athletic build, about 178 cm, straight shoulders, upright posture
wardrobe: Black tailored single-breasted jacket with a slim fit and matte finish
Dark charcoal fine-knit crew-neck top underneath
Black leather dress shoes with a subtle polish
Slim dark watch with a black leather strap

product.name: the fragrance
product.form: Heavy rectangular faceted flacon with thick glass walls, beveled shoulders and a squat, weighty base; a monumental amber glass obelisk at giant scale in scenes 1-2, revealed as the same bottle on a table in scenes 3-4
product.materials: Polished amber glass with crisp cut facets that catch light, thick glass base, solid heavy cap in brushed gold-toned metal with a polished edge
product.colors: Deep amber glass glowing honey-orange from within, brushed gold cap, black marble surroundings
product.branding_style: No visible lettering or logos; wordless, with a plain smooth glass face and the label side turned away from camera
distinctive_features: Inner amber glow that makes the glass look lit from within
Sharp faceted edges that carry a thin golden highlight
Heavy brushed-gold cap with a crisp polished rim
product.hero_angle: Straight-on, slightly low camera angle, bottle centered on polished black marble with a sharp mirror reflection beneath it

color_grade.contrast: High contrast with rich deep blacks, controlled highlights and no clipped whites
color_grade.saturation: Saturated amber and gold against restrained desaturated teal-black shadows
color_grade.film_emulation: Cinematic anamorphic look with soft horizontal flares and fine film grain, similar to a Kodak Vision3 500T print

location.primary: A vast, endless black marble hall with towering columns, a mirror-polished floor and no other light sources
secondary: A black marble table in the same dark hall holding the bottle
A polished black marble surface in a dark void for the final close-up

output.mood: Mysterious, monumental and awe-inspiring, becoming confident, revelatory and premium by the end
output.lighting: Single hard amber key (2700-3000K) from the glowing glass source, with a thin cool teal rim (6000-7000K) and very low teal ambient fill, deep black shadows and long amber reflections on polished marble; scenes only deviate in key direction
output.audio_mood: Deep cinematic sub-bass drone with a slow rising swell, soft airy reverb in the hall, a single resonant chime at the reveal, and a warm low resolving tone on the final shot, no voices
forbidden: No readable text, letters, numbers or logos anywhere in the frame
No invented brand name or lettering on the bottle or label
No other light sources or colourful neon
No cheap gold chains or flashy jewelry
No revealing or tight clothing on the man
